summary: The filing is an 8-K/A amendment to correct the net asset value per share of the Fund's Class I shares from $25.00 to $24.66. The Fund reports its aggregate NAV of approximately $166.9 million, fair value of its investment portfolio of $370.1 million, and $215.3 million of debt outstanding. It describes a continuous public offering of up to $1.0 billion in common shares, with ongoing sales of Class I shares in both the public offering and a private offering. This is a routine disclosure of NAV and offering status, not a special situation.
